title: Magic Kettle Appears
clips: Setting: bright cheerful kids kitchen, mint-green cabinets, sunny window, colourful utensils. Hoji finds a small dusty teapot on a high kitchen shelf and pulls it down He sets it on the table; it wobbles and lets out one tiny sparkly puff of steam
Setting: bright cheerful kids kitchen, mint-green cabinets, sunny window, colourful utensils. Mariyam peeks in from the side, eyes wide, whispering wow
Setting: bright cheerful kids kitchen, mint-green cabinets, sunny window, colourful utensils. The teapot hops once, twice, and grows a little bigger with each hop
Setting: bright cheerful kids kitchen, mint-green cabinets, sunny window, colourful utensils. It sprouts little handles and a smiling face; both kids back away amazed
